name: Default
shortDescription: Web app for reference-based audio mastering: upload a target track and a reference track, get the target matched in loudness, frequency response, peak level and stereo width.

alerts.message: The web app has no login and runs Django in debug mode: anyone who knows its URL can upload tracks and use your server's CPU. Upstream builds it for home and in-house use, not public hosting.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
